ValidationRule.description: Partner(s) is required when Prime or Sub Contractor is Sub Contractor ("Partner Needed" allowed). Records created before 2026-08-31 and Bypass CapStrat Validation holders are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_CapStrat_Validation) && OR(ISNEW(), CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE("2026-08-31 00:00:00")) && ISPICKVAL(Primary_Bidder__c, "Sub Contractor") && ISBLANK(Partner_s__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select Partner(s) when bidding as a Sub Contractor. If a partner is not yet secured, choose "Partner Needed".
